mapper.select:
select gameplame, SUM(gamecell) as gamecell, SUM(gamecell) - SUM(plampfit) as paicai, SUM(plampfit) as gameprofit from report_plam_games
and gameplame = #{gameplame}
AND begindate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{begindate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND begindate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY gameplame
UNION all select '送礼金额' as liveprop, '0' as gamecell, '0' as paicai, SUM(ticket) from ${agentPlatformLive}.live_host_wage_day where id like concat(#{dateTime}, '%') and ticket is not NULL UNION all SELECT '主播结算打码' AS liveprop, '0' AS gamecell, '0' AS paicai, SUM( lottery_cost ) FROM ${agentPlatformLive}.live_host_wage_day WHERE id LIKE concat(#{dateTime}, '%') and lottery_cost is not NULL UNION ALL select '坐骑金额' as liveprop,'0' as gamecell,'0' as paicai,SUM(total_diamonds) from ${agentPlatformLive}.live_video_prop where p_user_id not in (select id from member_info
AND STATUS in ('2'))
AND create_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{begindate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND create_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND prop_id = '-2'
